Subject: Post-call: FinHealth security discovery / pen test & vuln mgmt next steps

Hi Oliver / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the call today — great to learn more about FinHealth’s security bar and the integrations you’re planning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned FinHealth requires SOC 2 Type II or equivalent attestation for vendor approval. Please confirm the scope (prod-only vs. prod+staging) you need from us. I’ve attached a one-page SOC 2 summary for quick review.

2) Vendor security questionnaire: you asked to kick off the vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ). If you can share the doc (or a link), we’ll start filling it out. If you prefer, we can provide our standard security pack first to save time.

3) Pen test / vuln management: to help us align with your procurement team, could you confirm the level of detail you need from our last third-party penetration test? Typical asks we see: redacted executive summary + list of CVEs/remediations and dates. We do not typically share raw vulnerability reports that include customer-specific infrastructure details, but we can share a supplier-appropriate summary.

4) SLAs & cadence: please let us know expected SLAs for vulnerability disclosure and remediation (e.g., critical: 72 hours, high: 7 days), and whether you require regular scanning cadence (monthly/quarterly). We have a standard vuln mgmt doc attached that outlines our typical timelines and processes.

Next steps I propose: I’ll send our SOC 2 one-pager and a pen-test request form so your security team can indicate exact items needed. I’ll loop in Rishi (security SE) and Dev (technical contact) to expedite any follow-ups.

Available to meet again Thurs or next week if useful.

Thanks,

-- 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, PenTest_Report_Request_Form.pdf

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few answers and clarifying questions from our side: 

- SOC 2: FinHealth requires SOC 2 Type II covering production systems. A one-page summary is great for initial review, but our procurement will request the full report under an NDA if we proceed.

- Questionnaire: I’ve attached our standard vendor questionnaire (SIG-lite) to this email. Can you confirm a point of contact for completing it? We’d like the answers from an engineering/security-side rather than sales.

- Pen test details: For vendor review we need: (1) Executive summary, (2) High/critical findings with CVE ids and remediations, and (3) Statement on whether any customer data was exposed. We understand sensitive raw logs must remain internal.

- SLAs: For our acceptance we typically expect critical issues to be acknowledged within 24–48 hours and a remediation plan within 7 business days. Monthly authenticated scanning is preferred, but quarterly is acceptable for early-phase integrations.

We’d like to get the questionnaire back within 10 business days if possible. Point of contact for our questionnaire: sara.patel@finhealth.com.

Thanks — I’m looping in our external pen-test vendor for any direct report-forwarding once we receive your summary.

Best,
Oliver

Thanks Marissa — received all attachments. A few quick items from our security team and pen-test vendor: 

- Timeline: we’ll review the SOC2 summary and pen-test request form and expect to return the filled SIG-lite within 10 business days. Our pen-test vendor (pen-test@thirdpartysec.com) will be on the distribution list for the exec summary.

- Reporting expectations: we accept redacted exec summaries and an ANSI-style CVE list with remediation dates. For any critical findings affecting customer data, we require notification within 24 hours and a public-facing remediation status update within 7 business days. For vulnerability disclosure, we can accept standard coordinated disclosure practices (30-day public disclosure window after vendor fix) but will coordinate on a case-by-case basis.

- Scanning cadence: monthly authenticated scans preferred. If Redwood cannot support monthly scans in our environment, we will accept quarterly scans + compensating controls (WAF, network segmentation, etc.). Please confirm.

- Next steps: sara.patel@finhealth.com will send the SIG-lite link; please return it with Rishi as the technical author. Our vendor will request the exec summary directly from you or via me.

Oliver
